title: Arkret Invite Delivery Request
description: Private service-to-service request used by an inviter-side Principal Server to deliver a Realm invite to the invitee-side Principal Server. The request carries an explicit invite address and introduction evidence; raw locator tokens are never written into durable Realm events.

invite_event.description: The ak.invite.create EventEnvelope or equivalent accepted event view being delivered.

subject_id.description: Stable principal did_core_id of the invite recipient.

recipient_service_id.description: Stable Principal Server service did_core_id that accepts invite delivery for subject_id.

route_assistance.description: Optional transport-only hints for recovering the same recipient_service_id route. This field is outside invite_event canonical bytes and MUST NOT be copied into invite_delivery_target or any Realm member cell; it does not extend invite/locator TTL or authorize delivery.

recipient_service_kind.description: v1 only allows Principal Server invite delivery. Omit by default; if present, the value MUST be principal_server.
v1 only allows Principal Server invite delivery. Omit by default; if present, the value MUST be principal_server.

consent_grant_ref.description: Event ref of the invitee-issued ak.consent.grant (scope invite or any) that authorizes the inviter to send Realm/Strand invites. High-trust evidence: it is material the invitee actively issued to the inviter, equivalent in trust to a locator_ref.

consent_id.description: Optional consent cell id locating the holder consent cell, to speed up receiver verification of the active grant dot.

handle.description: Canonical handle string the inviter used as the human-readable entry point.

handle_claim.description: Verified handle claim proving that handle resolves to invite_address.subject_id. The receiver MUST verify binding_state, proofs, expiry, issuer trust, visibility/audience policy, and that handle_claim.handle equals handle.

member_delivery_binding_candidate.description: Optional builder evidence returned by a Directory or trusted issuer for intent=invite. When present, verifiers MUST check subject_id, handle, recipient_service_id, audience, issuer_service_id, expiry and proofs against this delivery.

resolved_by.description: Optional stable Directory or issuer service did_core_id that supplied the handle resolution.

status.description: Generic receive status. It MUST NOT reveal whether subject_id exists or whether policy quarantined/dropped the invite. A holder-quarantine outcome MUST be reported as deferred with no disclosed_outcome. Only a receiver policy disclosure level of outcome may add disclosed_outcome, and only with delivered|blocked.

disclosed_outcome.description: Optional graded-disclosure result, closed to delivered|blocked. Present ONLY when the subject's receive policy disclosure level for this introduction trust tier is 'outcome' and the subject did not block the issuer; omitted (opaque) otherwise. delivered: the invite reached the holder surface awaiting acceptance; blocked: rejected by block list or policy. A holder-quarantine outcome MUST NOT be disclosed: it reveals holder-private consent state (identity/consent-model.md 6.1.1) and MUST be reported as status='deferred' with no disclosed_outcome, in the same response and timing equivalence class as rate-limit silent drop, timeout drop, holder-not-found and holder policy deny.
